skipped_columns.pass_h*: no pos_pass table (tul.spandec_per_pass false): the per-pass block geometry is undefined on this checkpoint, so the columns are SKIPPED rather than faked with `pos`

notes.state: the loop's EXIT state at the forced depth, read at the seam _tul_spandec_loss reads (_readout(h_slots), after _tul_cond_apply)
notes.exit_column: H=1 at spandec_max_tokens through `pos` — the tul/spandec_ce a training run logs
notes.pass_columns: H spans of spandec_pass_tokens each through `pos_pass`
notes.mask: horizon_span_slots' rule, depth-independent by construction and CHECKED per batch: a slot is scored in a column only when every span that column needs exists and is complete
notes.K: K{a}-K{b} = CE at depth a minus CE at depth b; POSITIVE means the deeper state is better. Paired bootstrap over rows.
notes.eval_only: an eval-time depth intervention; pair a moving column with a depth-1-TRAINED control before reading it as 'depth earns'
